title: Young Hellboy The Hidden Land #2 3 4 Lot Dark Horse 2021 Mike Mignola Sniegoski
condition_description: All three clean and bright with light handling wear. See photos.
description:
Lot of 3: Young Hellboy: The Hidden Land #2, #3 and #4 (of 4), Dark Horse Comics, 2021 - Dark Horse 35 Years. Story by Mike Mignola and Thomas E. Sniegoski, art by Craig Rousseau, colors by Dave Stewart. #2 is the Cover B variant by Rachele Aragno; #3 and #4 regular covers. $3.99 cover price each.

Back covers: #2 Black Hammer Visions ad; #3 and #4 Hellboy Holiday Ornament ad.

Condition: all three clean and bright with light handling wear (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
